scope: Existing immutable evidence and bounded static source inspection; no benchmark answers or individual failure identities used
variant_separation: EviCastKV and MosaicKV are names of the same project, not competing methods.
Exact selection, the source/storage variant, bounded-history adaptations, and the full six-mechanism hybrid are distinct experimental variants.
A historical parity gate does not automatically certify a changed implementation or source-storage transport.

prefixkv.verification_method: Read-only git ls-remote HEAD and refs/heads/master on audit date

passed_published_operating_point.retention_convention: Official distributed 0.5 profile; nominal paper operating point, not a shared physical-byte cap
passed_published_operating_point.rouge_conclusion: Measured official-path ROUGE-L, not an additional published-numeric reproduction pass

bounded_official_local_parity.scope: Diagnostic four-sample parity on the recorded legacy checkpoint, profile and decoder only

preserved_later_negative_parity.conclusion: Do not generalize the earlier passing path to altered configurations or erase this failure

completed_large_local_campaign.reuse_rule: Preserve all compatible predictions and negative outcomes; no whole original campaign rerun

new_evidence_only_if_claimed: Bind the exact current implementation and decode policy to the already passing official/local path, or rerun only a bounded differential parity gate after a behavior-changing modification.
Label byte-rescaled, selection-only, question-scored, bounded-history and source-storage adaptations as adaptations, not official PrefixKV.

Any new cross-method superiority claim needs matched current controls, measured initial/final/peak storage and separately passing corpus PPL and reference ROUGE-L. Existing completeness alone does not supply it.

lookm.verification_method: Read-only git ls-remote HEAD and refs/heads/main on audit date; pinned local source AST inspection

official_history_check.conclusion: The released import is broken, not necessarily the algorithm. No reason to call the baseline permanently unfixable.

existing_dispatch_evidence.KV_DICT_only_occurrence: Definition at llava_llama.py:76; no internal reader found
existing_dispatch_evidence.bounded_repair_hypothesis: Removing the stale missing import and unused invalid dictionary may preserve the actual intended dispatch. This is an untested isolated compatibility-patch proposal, not an executed reproduction.

narrow_patched_cpu_import_diagnostic.classification: patched official-path CPU import diagnostic, not unmodified official execution

Remove KV_DICT, verified to have no internal reader.

synthetic_random_weight_cpu_smoke.model_weights: randomly initialized CPU-only; no pretrained checkpoint
synthetic_random_weight_cpu_smoke.warning: Installed Transformers warns that the upstream legacy classes do not inherit GenerationMixin. Inspection of the actual tiny model confirms its parent has no generate method; no mixin shim was added. Synthetic forward/cache success does not certify native generation.

preserved_first_attempt.resolution: Separately authorized removal of this proven-unused import, not a package installation or arithmetic port

narrow_patched_cpu_import_diagnostic.next_boundary: Import plus a tiny random-model forward/cache/merge path now work with this explicit patch. Native generation API, real-checkpoint controls and the published operating point still require separate evidence; no larger campaign is justified by this synthetic success.

new_evidence_only_if_claimed: A separately pinned, audited and isolated compatibility patch plus differential algorithm checks is required before calling any execution a patched official-path reproduction.
Existing local MileBench measurements remain reimplementation evidence; report Accuracy and ROUGE-L separately and do not relabel consumed or source-group-unverified cohorts as fresh.

vl_cache.public_source_check: No official repository link was supplied on the inspected primary arXiv page; this is not proof that no implementation exists anywhere.
local_choices_not_official_results: Post-vision query scoring and sparsity-derived layer allocation are paper-derived; grouped-query reduction, recent-token interpretation, integer apportionment and dense physical-byte packing require explicit implementation labels.
Common HF execution does not reproduce the paper's specialized kernels or their reported acceleration.

preserved_local_comparison_example.conclusion: Existing measured reimplementation curves are not a published operating-point reproduction or fresh source-variant confirmation.

new_evidence_only_if_claimed: Compare paper-reported CIDEr/ANLS trends separately from local measurements; no exact reproduction label without matching checkpoint, dataset, prompts, generation, metric and budget convention.
Use current measured physical-byte controls for a unified local comparison; nominal 10% retention is not a 10 MiB target.

narrow_admissible_source_control.quality_reference: FullKV on the same actual checkpoint, processor, precision, attention implementation, inputs and generation schedule
remaining_execution_controls: Construct every compared cache, rather than accepting a feasibility witness or allocating dummy fill.
Preserve common mandatory policy, original logical positions, output length and exact realized comparison boundary.
Charge codes, scales, headers, protected regions, repairs, residuals, generated history and live reconstruction workspaces; distinguish persistent, decode-owned and whole-request peaks.
Pass numerical/clone/state-isolation controls before interpreting quality or latency.
Keep FullKV out of compressed-method latency ranking; source-variant results do not activate the six-mechanism hybrid.
Freeze controls and independently validate quality before any superiority statement.
narrow_admissible_source_control.bounded_next_action: Complete current same-consumed-input construction and ownership controls first. Do not rerun historical nominal-ratio campaigns merely to satisfy a generic baseline checklist.

documentation_caution: Historical readiness and parity Markdown reports predate later artifacts; use the hash-bound gate and its explicit eligibility scope rather than stale prose.
